key.name: mirror-gtk-settings
key.summary: Mirror MATE settings for native GTK applications
key.description: Copy the MATE interface, font, mouse and sound settings that mate-settings-daemon publishes as XSETTINGS into org.gnome.desktop.*, which GTK and xdg-desktop-portal-gtk read on Wayland. The copy is written to your dconf database, so GNOME sessions see it too.

key.name: phase-timeout
key.description: Seconds to wait for the applications of a session phase before starting the next phase.

key.name: trusted-components
key.description: Desktop ids or program names that may use privileged protocols, beside the required components.

key.name: trusted-executables
key.summary: Executables trusted without being started by Polo
key.description: Absolute paths of programs that may use privileged protocols although D-Bus, not Polo, starts them, such as the portal backend. A program counts only while its file is owned by root and writable by nobody else.

key.name: x11-components
key.description: Desktop ids or program names started with GDK_BACKEND=x11, because they call X directly.

key.name: restore-window-state
key.description: Save each window's workspace, geometry, maximized, minimized, sticky and above state at logout, and give it back to the first window with the same app id and title at the next login.

key.name: locker-command
key.description: An ext-session-lock-v1 locker, used when mate-screensaver is not running. It runs as a trusted client. Empty uses none.

key.name: wobbly-windows
key.description: Animate windows with the Wobbly effect while moving or resizing them.

key.name: wobbly-level
key.description: Select the Wobbly effect preset; 0 uses the default preset.

key.name: wobbly-move
key.description: Apply the Wobbly effect while moving windows.

key.name: wobbly-resize
key.description: Apply the Wobbly effect while resizing windows.

key.name: wobbly-stiffness
key.description: Override the preset stiffness; -1 uses the selected preset.

key.name: wobbly-drag
key.description: Override the preset drag; -1 uses the selected preset.

key.name: wobbly-move-factor
key.description: Override the preset movement factor; -1 uses the selected preset.

key.name: wobbly-min-velocity
key.description: Minimum velocity for Wobbly movement response.

key.name: wobbly-max-velocity
key.description: Maximum velocity for Wobbly movement response.

key.name: wobbly-stop-velocity
key.description: Velocity below which the Wobbly simulation can settle.

key.name: wobbly-min-acceleration
key.description: Minimum acceleration for Wobbly movement response.

key.name: wobbly-max-acceleration
key.description: Maximum acceleration for Wobbly movement response.

key.name: wobbly-stop-acceleration
key.description: Acceleration below which the Wobbly simulation can settle.

key.name: wobbly-mesh-spacing
key.description: Spacing in pixels between vertices in the Wobbly deformation grid.

key.name: magic-lamp
key.description: Kept for settings made before minimize-animation: when true and minimize-animation is "none", minimising uses Magic Lamp.

key.name: open-animation
key.description: How a window appears when it opens: at once ("none"), fading in ("fade"), growing from a third of its size while fading in ("zoom"), fading in then stretching across and then down ("zap"), or spinning in from a point ("spin").

key.name: close-animation
key.description: How a window disappears when it closes, the open animations run backwards: "none", "fade", "zoom", "zap" or "spin".

key.name: minimize-animation
key.description: How a window goes into its task bar button when minimised, and comes back out when restored: at once ("none"), fading ("fade"), shrinking into the button ("zoom"), squeezing into it ("squeezimize") or funnelling into it ("magic-lamp"). Squeezimize and Magic Lamp need the GL renderer and fade instead without it.

key.name: animation-duration-ms
key.description: Duration in milliseconds of the fade and zoom animations.

key.name: zap-duration-ms
key.description: Duration in milliseconds of the zap animation.

key.name: spin-duration-ms
key.description: Duration in milliseconds of the spin animation.

key.name: spin-rotations
key.description: How many turns the spin animation makes; negative turns the other way.

key.name: squeezimize-duration-ms
key.description: Duration in milliseconds of the squeezimize animation.

key.name: magic-lamp-duration-ms
key.description: Duration in milliseconds for the Magic Lamp animation.

key.name: expo
key.description: Show every workspace side by side with its expo key, to pick a workspace or drag windows between workspaces.

key.name: expo-layout
key.description: How Expo arranges the workspaces: as the workspace switcher lays them out ("workspaces"), in one row ("row"), or in a grid as square as possible ("grid").

key.name: expo-workspace-names
key.description: Show each workspace's name under it in Expo.

key.name: expo-label-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of Expo's workspace name boxes
key.description: How opaque the dark box behind each workspace name is, from 0 (only the text) to 1; the media key OSDs use 0.75.

key.name: expo-label-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of Expo's workspace name boxes
key.description: The radius in pixels of the corners of the box behind each workspace name; 0 gives square corners.

key.name: expo-background
key.description: What Expo shows behind the workspaces: a solid dark grey ("solid"), the desktop background ("wallpaper"), or the desktop background blurred ("blurred-wallpaper").

key.name: expo-background-blur
key.description: How far, in pixels, the "blurred-wallpaper" Expo background is blurred.

key.name: expo-background-dim
key.description: How much darker the wallpaper behind Expo is drawn, from 0 (as is) to 1 (black).

key.name: cube
key.description: Shows workspace switches within a row of workspaces as a turning cube, and enables the cube keys of org.mate.polo.keybindings. Needs the GL renderer; otherwise workspaces switch as without it.

key.name: cube-duration-ms
key.description: Duration in milliseconds of a turn of the cube, and of zooming it in and out.

key.name: cube-zoom
key.description: How far the camera moves back while the cube is turned by hand; 0 does not zoom out.

key.name: cube-speed-zoom
key.description: How much one scroll step zooms the cube.

key.name: cube-speed-spin-horizontal
key.description: Radians the cube turns per pixel of pointer motion across.

key.name: cube-speed-spin-vertical
key.description: How far the cube tilts per pixel of pointer motion up and down.

key.name: cube-natural-drag
key.summary: Natural turning of the desktop cube
key.description: Reverses turning the cube with the pointer, across and up and down alike, as natural scrolling reverses the wheel: the cube follows the pointer like a surface being pushed, instead of the view moving with it.

key.name: cube-deform
key.description: Bends the cube's sides while it is turned by hand: not at all ("none"), into a cylinder ("cylinder"), or pulling the corners out ("star").

key.name: cube-light
key.description: Shades the cube's sides by how they face the light in front of the screen.

key.name: cube-background
key.description: What shows behind the cube: cube-background-color ("solid"), the desktop background ("wallpaper"), the desktop background blurred as Expo's ("blurred-wallpaper"), cube-skydome-image on a sphere around the cube ("skydome"), or cube-cubemap-image on a box around it ("cubemap"). A missing image falls back to "solid".

key.name: cube-background-color
key.description: The colour behind the cube with the "solid" background, as #rrggbb.

key.name: cube-skydome-image
key.description: The image file shown around the cube with the "skydome" background.

key.name: cube-skydome-mirror
key.description: Shows the skydome image twice round the sphere, the second time mirrored, so its ends meet without a seam.

key.name: cube-cubemap-image
key.description: The image file shown on the six faces of a box around the cube with the "cubemap" background.

key.name: cube-mesh-spacing
key.description: Pixels between the points at which the cube's sides are computed; smaller is smoother and slower. Deformed sides use at least 30 points across.

key.name: expo
key.description: Shows every workspace side by side, in Marco's accelerator syntax ("disabled" for none).

key.name: display-mode
key.summary: Choose how the screens are used
key.description: Opens the display-mode popup (primary screen only, mirror, extend, secondary screen only) when two or more screens are connected, in Marco's accelerator syntax ("disabled" for none). Pressing it again with the modifier held moves on; releasing the modifier applies. The laptop's display key (XF86Display) opens it too.

key.name: cube
key.description: Opens the desktop cube zoomed out, to turn it by hand and pick the workspace in front, in Marco's accelerator syntax ("disabled" for none). Needs the cube key of org.mate.polo.effects.

key.name: cube-rotate-left
key.description: Turns the cube one workspace to the left and ends on it, in Marco's accelerator syntax ("disabled" for none). Marco's switch-to-workspace-left also turns the cube.

key.name: cube-rotate-right
key.description: Turns the cube one workspace to the right and ends on it, in Marco's accelerator syntax ("disabled" for none). Marco's switch-to-workspace-right also turns the cube.

key.name: cube-drag
key.summary: Turn the desktop cube with the pointer
key.description: Modifiers and a pointer button (Button1 left, Button2 middle, Button3 right, Button8 back, Button9 forward) that turn the cube while held; letting go lands on the workspace in front. At least one modifier is needed; "disabled" for none. Applications do not get that click.
